name: Marrickville Big Cubes Day 2022
information: Please note: this competition does not have 3x3 as it is focussed on big cubes. We are holding two mini competition the next day which includes 3x3, you can compete in the Big Cubes competition as well as one of the [AM](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleMiniOpenAM2022) or [PM](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MarrickvilleMiniOpenPM2022) mini competition. ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
